# Vladimir Podlevskikh — Physics & Maths Tutor

> Online one-to-one physics and mathematics tutoring for IB, AP, SAT, A-Level, IGCSE and ЕГЭ. Taught by an MSU (Lomonosov Moscow State University) physicist with 23+ years of experience and 350+ students prepared. Perfect score of 200/200 on both the US Praxis Physics and Praxis Mathematics exams. Based in Yerevan, Armenia (GMT+4); lessons online worldwide in English and/or Russian. Payment in USD/EUR via Payoneer or secure card link.

## Key facts
- Tutor: Vladimir Podlevskikh, physicist, Lomonosov Moscow State University (MSU).
- Experience: 23+ years, 350+ students, 20+ olympiad medalists, 4.88★ from 127 verified reviews.
- Certification: perfect 200/200 on US Praxis Physics AND Praxis Mathematics.
- Currently teaches physics in English at an international school (Nyberg School, Yerevan).
- Languages: English and Russian (bilingual lessons available).
- Pricing: Standard $390/month (1 lesson/week); Intensive $680/month (2 lessons/week, ~$85/session); Premium IB HL / Olympiad coaching $120–135/hour; one-off trial $90/60 min; self-paced study plan from $49. Exact plan set on a free 20-minute diagnostic.

## Programmes (pillar pages)
- [IB Physics Tutor (HL & SL)](https://tutor.podlevskikh.com/ib-physics-tutor/): IB Physics HL and SL, Internal Assessment support, Paper 1/2/3 technique, the 1–7 scale.
- [AP Physics Tutor (1, 2, C)](https://tutor.podlevskikh.com/ap-physics-tutor/): AP Physics 1, 2 and C (Mechanics and E&M), free-response technique, route to a 5; calculus taught with the physics.
- [Репетитор по физике онлайн](https://tutor.podlevskikh.com/physics-tutor-online/): online physics tutoring in Russian — ЕГЭ, ОГЭ, ДВИ, olympiads, IB, AP, A-Level.
- [Подготовка к ЕГЭ по физике](https://tutor.podlevskikh.com/ege-physics/): Russian state exam (ЕГЭ) physics preparation, both parts, marking-scheme-aligned, week-by-week plan, ДВИ track.

## Segments
- [Репетитор для русскоязычных за рубежом](https://tutor.podlevskikh.com/russian-tutor-abroad/): physics & maths for Russian-speaking families abroad; help transitioning from a Russian school into an international (IB/AP/A-Level/IGCSE) school, in English, Russian or both.
- [Подготовка к олимпиадам](https://tutor.podlevskikh.com/olympiad-physics/): physics & maths olympiad coaching — Russian National Olympiad (ВсОШ), perechnevye olympiads, IPhO-style; admission benefits (БВИ).

## Method blog (worked problems & exam technique)
- [Как читать графики движения](https://tutor.podlevskikh.com/blog/kinematics-grafiki/): reading x(t), v(t), a(t) motion graphs — slope vs area, common ЕГЭ/IB/AP traps.
- [Второй закон Ньютона: типовые задачи и ошибки](https://tutor.podlevskikh.com/blog/newton-zakony-zadachi/): Newton's second law — free-body diagrams, choosing axes, inclined planes, connected bodies, friction sign errors.
- [IB Physics Paper 2: structuring long-answer questions](https://tutor.podlevskikh.com/blog/ib-physics-paper-2/): command terms, calculation layout, "explain" answers, data and uncertainties.
